cautions: 孕婦慎用。

location_zh: 下腹部，髂前上棘的前下方 0.5 寸（五樞前下）。
location_en: On the lower abdomen, 0.5 cun anteroinferior to the anterior superior iliac spine.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation and discharge, promotes water metabolism.
contraindications: 孕婦慎用。
needling: 直刺或斜刺 0.8-1.2 寸。
cautions: 孕婦慎用。

location_zh: 髖區，髂前上棘與股骨大轉子最高點連線的中點處。
location_en: In the hip region, at the midpoint between the anterior superior iliac spine and the prominence of the greater trochanter.

contraindications: 局部皮膚破損時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損時避開。

cautions: 局部皮膚破損時避開。

cautions: 局部皮膚破損時避開。

functions_zh: 寧神定志，舒筋活絡。陽維脈郄穴。
functions_en: Calms the spirit, relaxes the sinews. Xi-cleft of the Yang Linking Vessel.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損時避開。

cautions: 局部皮膚破損時避開。

location_zh: 足背，第 4、5 蹠骨底結合部的前方，第 5 趾長伸肌腱外側凹陷中。
location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, anterior to the junction of the bases of the 4th and 5th metatarsals, in the depression lateral to the tendon of extensor digiti minimi.

functions_en: Spreads liver qi, benefits the ears and eyes. Jing-well and metal point.

cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

cautions: 深部近肱動脈，針刺須避開血管；出血傾向者慎點刺。

contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

cautions: 深部為正中神經，避免強刺激與反覆提插。

cautions: 針感強烈，暈針史者慎用。

location_zh: 中指末端最高點（中指尖端中央）。
location_en: At the center of the tip of the middle finger.
functions_zh: 開竅醒神，清心泄熱。井木穴。
functions_en: Revives consciousness, clears heart heat. Jing-well and wood point.
contraindications: 急救用穴；出血傾向者慎點刺。
needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或三稜針點刺出血。
cautions: 急救用穴；出血傾向者慎點刺。

location_zh: 足大趾末節外側，趾甲角旁開 0.1 寸。
location_en: On the lateral side of the distal phalanx of the great toe, 0.1 cun from the corner of the toenail.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止淋，回陽救逆。井木穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation, rescues yang. Jing-well and wood point.
contraindications: 孕婦慎灸。
needling: 斜刺 0.1-0.2 寸，或點刺出血；疝氣、崩漏傳統多用灸。
cautions: 孕婦慎灸。

location_zh: 足背，第 1、2 趾之間，趾蹼緣後方赤白肉際處。
location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 1st and 2nd toes, proximal to the web margin at the border of the red and white skin.
functions_zh: 清肝瀉火，涼血安神，熄風活絡。滎火穴。
functions_en: Drains liver fire, cools blood, calms the spirit, extinguishes wind. Ying-spring and fire point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
needling: 直刺或斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 內踝前 1 寸，脛骨前肌腱內側緣凹陷中（商丘與解溪連線之間）。
location_en: 1 cun anterior to the medial malleolus, in the depression medial to the tendon of tibialis anterior.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，清瀉濕熱。經金穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, drains damp-heat. Jing-river and metal point.
contraindications: 局部肌腱處避免強力提插。
cautions: 局部肌腱處避免強力提插。

location_zh: 小腿內側，內踝尖上 5 寸，脛骨內側面中央。
location_en: On the medial lower leg, 5 cun proximal to the tip of the medial malleolus, at the center of the medial surface of the tibia.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止帶。絡穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation and discharge. Luo-connecting point.
contraindications: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。
needling: 平刺 0.5-0.8 寸（骨面上沿皮刺）。
cautions: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。

location_zh: 小腿內側，內踝尖上 7 寸，脛骨內側面中央。
location_en: On the medial lower leg, 7 cun proximal to the tip of the medial malleolus, at the center of the medial surface of the tibia.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，調經止血。郄穴。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, regulates menstruation, stops bleeding. Xi-cleft point.
contraindications: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。
cautions: 骨面淺薄，不宜深刺。

location_zh: 膝內側，脛骨內側髁下方，陰陵泉（SP9）後方 1 寸。
location_en: On the medial knee, below the medial condyle of the tibia, 1 cun posterior to SP9 Yinlingquan.
indications_en: Lower limb atrophy or painful obstruction
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 膝內側，屈膝時膝內側橫紋端上方凹陷中，半腱肌、半膜肌止端前緣。
location_en: On the medial knee, with the knee flexed, in the depression proximal to the medial end of the popliteal crease, anterior to the insertions of semitendinosus and semimembranosus.
functions_zh: 清利濕熱，補益肝腎，調經止帶。合水穴。
functions_en: Clears damp-heat, supplements liver and kidney, regulates menstruation. He-sea and water point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 大腿內側，髕底上 4 寸，股薄肌與縫匠肌之間。
location_en: On the medial thigh, 4 cun proximal to the base of the patella, between gracilis and sartorius.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation, relieves pain, promotes urination.
indications_en: Lumbosacral pain radiating to the lower abdomen
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 大腿內側，氣衝（ST30）直下 3 寸，動脈搏動處內側，長收肌前緣。
location_en: On the medial thigh, 3 cun distal to ST30 Qichong, on the anterior border of adductor longus.
functions_zh: 疏肝理氣，清利下焦濕熱。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, clears damp-heat from the lower burner.
contraindications: 鄰近股血管，針刺避開搏動處。
needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸；避開股動、靜脈。
danger: Femoral vessels nearby — avoid the pulsating artery.
cautions: 鄰近股血管，針刺避開搏動處。

location_zh: 大腿內側，氣衝（ST30）直下 2 寸。
location_en: On the medial thigh, 2 cun distal to ST30 Qichong.
functions_en: Regulates menstruation and discharge, frees the lower burner.
contraindications: 鄰近股血管，避開搏動處。
needling: 直刺 0.8-1 寸；避開股血管。
cautions: 鄰近股血管，避開搏動處。

location_zh: 腹股溝區，恥骨聯合下緣中點旁開 2.5 寸，股動脈搏動處外側。
location_en: In the inguinal region, 2.5 cun lateral to the midpoint of the inferior border of the pubic symphysis, lateral to the femoral artery.
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, relieves pain in the inguinal region.
contraindications: 緊鄰股動脈，針刺須先觸清搏動位置並避開；孕婦慎用。
needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸，必須避開股動脈；傳統多灸少針。
danger: Femoral artery immediately medial — palpate and avoid.
cautions: 緊鄰股動脈，針刺須先觸清搏動位置並避開；孕婦慎用。

location_zh: 側腹部，第 11 肋游離端下際。
location_en: On the lateral abdomen, below the free end of the 11th rib.
functions_zh: 疏肝健脾，理氣散結。脾之募穴、臟會。
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, fortifies the spleen, dissipates masses. Front-mu of the spleen; hui-meeting of the zang.
contraindications: 深部為肝（右）脾（左），肝脾腫大者尤其不可深刺。
needling: 斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可深刺 — 右側深部為肝，左側深部為脾。
danger: Liver (right) and spleen (left) lie deep to this point — no deep insertion, especially with organomegaly.
cautions: 深部為肝（右）脾（左），肝脾腫大者尤其不可深刺。

location_zh: 無名指末節尺側，指甲角旁開 0.1 寸。
location_en: On the ulnar side of the distal phalanx of the ring finger, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail.
functions_zh: 清熱解表，開竅醒神。井金穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, releases the exterior, revives consciousness. Jing-well and metal point.
contraindications: 出血傾向者慎點刺。
needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血。
cautions: 出血傾向者慎點刺。

location_zh: 手背，第 4、5 指之間，指蹼緣後方赤白肉際處。
location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, between the 4th and 5th fingers, proximal to the web margin at the border of the red and white skin.
functions_en: Clears the head and eyes, regulates the triple burner. Ying-spring and water point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 手背，第 4、5 掌骨間，第 4 掌指關節近端凹陷中。
location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, between the 4th and 5th metacarpals, in the depression proximal to the 4th metacarpophalangeal joint.
functions_zh: 清熱通絡，開竅益聰。輸木穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, benefits the ears. Shu-stream and wood point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 腕背側遠端橫紋上，指總伸肌腱尺側緣凹陷中。
location_en: On the dorsal wrist crease, in the depression ulnar to the tendon of extensor digitorum.
functions_zh: 清熱通絡，益陰增液。原穴。
functions_en: Clears heat, unblocks the channel, engenders fluids. Yuan-source point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 3 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
location_en: On the posterior forearm, 3 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_zh: 清利三焦，通腑降逆。經火穴。
functions_en: Clears the triple burner, moves the bowels. Jing-river and fire point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 3 寸，尺骨橈側緣。
location_en: On the posterior forearm, 3 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, on the radial border of the ulna.
functions_zh: 清利三焦，安神定志。郄穴。
functions_en: Clears the triple burner, calms the spirit. Xi-cleft point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 前臂後區，腕背側遠端橫紋上 4 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
location_en: On the posterior forearm, 4 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_en: Relaxes the sinews, opens the voice, benefits the ears.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 前臂後區，肘尖（鷹嘴）下 5 寸，尺骨與橈骨間隙中點。
location_en: On the posterior forearm, 5 cun distal to the tip of the olecranon, midway between the ulna and radius.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, clears the throat.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 肘後區，肘尖（鷹嘴）上 1 寸凹陷中。
location_en: On the posterior elbow, in the depression 1 cun proximal to the tip of the olecranon.
functions_zh: 行氣散結，安神通絡。合土穴。
functions_en: Moves qi, dissipates nodules, calms the spirit. He-sea and earth point.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 臂後區，肘尖上 2 寸（天井上 1 寸）。
location_en: On the posterior arm, 2 cun proximal to the tip of the olecranon, 1 cun above TE10.
functions_en: Clears heat, dispels wind, unblocks the channel.
indications_en: Shoulder and arm pain limiting elevation
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 臂後區，清冷淵與臑會連線的中點（肘尖上 5 寸）。
location_en: On the posterior arm, midway between TE11 and TE13, about 5 cun proximal to the olecranon.
functions_en: Clears heat, calms the spirit, unblocks the channel.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 臂後區，肩峰角下 3 寸，三角肌後下緣。
location_en: On the posterior arm, 3 cun distal to the angle of the acromion, on the posteroinferior border of deltoid.
functions_en: Transforms phlegm, dissipates nodules, relieves pain.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 肩峰角與肱骨大結節之間，臂外展時肩髃（LI15）後方凹陷中。
location_en: On the shoulder, in the depression posterior to LI15 when the arm is abducted, between the acromial angle and the greater tubercle of the humerus.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
needling: 直刺 0.8-1.2 寸（向極泉方向）。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 肩胛區，肩胛骨上角上方凹陷中（肩井與曲垣之間）。
location_en: In the scapular region, in the depression superior to the superior angle of the scapula, between GB21 and SI13.
contraindications: 深部近肺尖，深刺有氣胸風險。
needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可向前下深刺 — 肺尖在其深部。
danger: Apex of the lung lies deep — no deep insertion (pneumothorax risk).
cautions: 深部近肺尖，深刺有氣胸風險。

location_zh: 頸部，胸鎖乳突肌後緣，約平下頜角處。
location_en: On the neck, at the posterior border of sternocleidomastoid, level with the angle of the mandible.
functions_en: Clears the head, brightens the eyes, unblocks the channel.
contraindications: 頸部血管神經豐富，控制深度。
needling: 直刺 0.5-0.8 寸，避免深刺與強刺激。
cautions: 頸部血管神經豐富，控制深度。

location_zh: 耳垂後方，乳突與下頜角之間的凹陷中。
location_en: Posterior to the earlobe, in the depression between the mastoid process and the angle of the mandible.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, dispels wind, drains heat.
contraindications: 深部為面神經與頸部血管，控制方向與深度。
needling: 直刺 0.8-1 寸；深部有面神經幹與血管，避免粗暴提插。
danger: Facial nerve trunk and deep vessels beneath — gentle technique only.
cautions: 深部為面神經與頸部血管，控制方向與深度。

location_zh: 耳後乳突中央，角孫（TE20）至翳風（TE17）沿耳輪弧形連線的下 1/3 與上 2/3 交點。
location_en: At the center of the mastoid, at the junction of the lower third and upper two-thirds of the curve from TE20 to TE17 behind the ear.
functions_en: Extinguishes wind, relieves spasm, benefits the ears.
contraindications: 出血傾向者慎點刺。
needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸，或點刺出血。
cautions: 出血傾向者慎點刺。

location_zh: 耳後，角孫（TE20）至翳風（TE17）弧形連線的上 1/3 與下 2/3 交點。
location_en: Behind the ear, at the junction of the upper third and lower two-thirds of the curve from TE20 to TE17.
functions_en: Benefits the ears, drains heat, settles fright.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 頭部，折耳向前，耳尖直上入髮際處。
location_en: On the head, directly above the ear apex within the hairline when the ear is folded forward.
functions_en: Clears heat, reduces swelling, dispels wind.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；痄腮傳統常用燈心草灸（燈火灸）。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 耳區，耳屏上切跡與下頜骨髁突之間，張口呈凹陷處。
location_en: In front of the ear, in the depression between the supratragic notch and the condylar process of the mandible, located with the mouth open.
functions_en: Opens the portals, benefits the ears, drains heat.
contraindications: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。
cautions: 局部皮膚破損或感染時避開。

location_zh: 頭側部，鬢髮後緣，耳廓根前方，顳淺動脈的後緣。
location_en: On the side of the head, posterior to the temporal hairline, anterior to the auricular root, posterior to the superficial temporal artery.
functions_en: Dispels wind, unblocks the channel, reduces swelling.
contraindications: 緊鄰顳淺動脈，須先觸清搏動並避開。
needling: 避開顳淺動脈，斜刺或平刺 0.3-0.5 寸。
danger: Superficial temporal artery adjacent — palpate and avoid.
cautions: 緊鄰顳淺動脈，須先觸清搏動並避開。

location_zh: 面部，眉梢凹陷處。
location_en: On the face, in the depression at the lateral end of the eyebrow.
functions_en: Clears the head, brightens the eyes, dispels wind.
contraindications: 傳統禁灸；局部皮膚破損時避開。
needling: 平刺 0.5-1 寸；傳統列為禁灸穴。
cautions: 傳統禁灸；局部皮膚破損時避開。
